chatHistory.content:
Part 1: Raw Description (Shot-by-Shot)
Beat 1: CRT Boot Flash (0:00:00:00 – 0:00:00:04)
Screen is black. A quick lavender-white flash pulses twice (mimicking a CRT monitor powering on), then settles back to the dark background. Sets the mood: retro, terminal, hacker aesthetic.
Beat 2: Pixel Bubble Assembly (0:00:00:05 – 0:00:02:00)
The pixel art chat bubble builds itself block by block. Each pixel pops in from nothing (scale 0 → 1) with a brief white flash/glow on arrival that fades within 3 frames. The build order is top-left to bottom-right, staggered so each pixel appears ~1.5 frames after the previous one. The bubble is rendered as a grid of square blocks (roughly 28px each with 4px gaps at 4K) using a lavender/purple tone (#C0A0D8). The tail of the speech bubble (bottom-left two pixels) lands last, completing the icon. By frame 50, the full bubble is static and settled.
Beat 3: "INTEL:" Header Punch-In (0:00:02:02 – 0:00:02:15)
"INTEL:" types in immediately left-aligned below the bubble. Large, bold, near-white (#E8E4F0), monospace font. The colon blinks on/off a few times (4-frame interval) before settling solid. A subtle horizontal scanline sweeps down the text area as it appears, reinforcing the CRT feel. The header slides in slightly from the left (translateX -20 → 0).
Beat 4: Stat Lines — Typewriter Sequence (0:00:02:18 – 0:00:05:13)
Four stat lines type in sequentially with a block cursor (▌), each starting after the previous is partially done. Typing speed is ~0.55 characters per frame. Each line has a two-tone color split: the key stat (number/adjective) in pink-lavender (#D4A8CC) and the descriptor in periwinkle-blue (#9898D0).

Line 1 starts frame 68: "250+ operatives expected."
Line 2 starts frame 88: "10+ speakers."
Line 3 starts frame 106: "Unlimited beer."
Line 4 starts frame 122: "Zero rate limits."

The block cursor appears at the start of each line's typing and blinks after completion for ~30 frames before disappearing. Each line fades to full opacity instantly when its typing begins (no pre-fade).
Beat 5: Settle + Ambient Glow (0:00:05:15 – 0:00:07:00)
All text is now static. A soft radial glow (lavender, heavily blurred, ~50% opacity) fades in behind the entire content block, pulsing gently with a slow sine wave. All cursors stop blinking. The composition holds clean for a final frame grab. Optional: subtle vignette darkening at the edges.

Part 2: Remotion Code-Gen Prompt
Create a single Remotion composition (3840×2160, 25fps, 175 frames / 7 seconds) for a retro terminal-style event teaser animation.
Design system:

Background: solid #0B0B14 (very dark blue-black), no background image — this is a standalone piece, not b-roll
No safe zone cropping needed (content is centered with generous padding)
Font: JetBrains Mono (fallback: Fira Code, SF Mono) — monospace throughout
Pixel color: #C0A0D8 (lavender)
Header color: #E8E4F0 (near-white)
Stat highlight color: #D4A8CC (pink-lavender) — used for "250+", "10+", "Unlimited", "Zero"
Stat descriptor color: #9898D0 (periwinkle-blue) — used for "operatives expected.", "speakers.", "beer.", "rate limits."
Cursor color: #E8E4F0
Ambient glow: rgba(192,160,216,0.25)
Motion: spring({ damping: 200 }) for all entrances, interpolate() with clamp for typewriter and flash effects

Layout:
All content is left-aligned in a vertically and horizontally centered container. Stack order top to bottom: pixel bubble → 24px gap → "INTEL:" header → 8px gap → four stat lines (8px line gap). Container has ~200px horizontal padding and ~120px vertical padding from the canvas center.
PHASE 1 — CRT Boot (frames 0–4):
Full-screen overlay flashes from 0 → 0.3 → 0 → 0.08 opacity using lavender-white rgba(200,180,220,N) across frames 0, 2, 4, 6. Hard interpolate keyframes, no spring. This simulates a CRT powering on.
PHASE 2 — Pixel Bubble Assembly (frames 5–50):
Render the chat bubble as an 8-column × 7-row grid of square blocks (28px with 4px gap). The pixel layout (1 = filled, 0 = empty):
Row 0: 0 0 1 1 1 1 0 0
Row 1: 0 1 1 1 1 1 1 0
Row 2: 0 1 1 1 1 1 1 0
Row 3: 0 1 1 1 1 1 1 0
Row 4: 0 0 1 1 1 1 0 0
Row 5: 0 1 1 0 0 0 0 0
Row 6: 1 1 0 0 0 0 0 0
Total filled pixels: 26. Each pixel appears via spring({ damping: 200 }) with staggered delays: pixel N starts at frame 5 + N * (40 / 26) (roughly 1.5 frames apart), building top-left to bottom-right. Each pixel scales from 0 → 1 and has a white box-shadow flash (0 0 12px #FFFFFF) that peaks 3 frames after appearance and fades to nothing by frame +8. Empty cells are invisible spacers maintaining the grid.
PHASE 3 — "INTEL:" Header (frames 52–65):
"INTEL:" appears at frame 52 via spring({ damping: 200 }). Font size 72px, weight 900, color #E8E4F0, letter-spacing 0.08em. Entrance: opacity 0 → 1 + translateX from -20px → 0. The colon blinks: visible on even 4-frame intervals, invisible on odd, for frames 52–82. After frame 82 the colon stays solid.
PHASE 4 — Typewriter Stat Lines (frames 68–138):
Four text lines, each rendered as a horizontal sequence of colored <span> elements. Typewriter function: displayedText = fullText.slice(0, Math.floor((frame - startFrame) * 0.55)). Each line is invisible (opacity 0) until its start frame, then opacity snaps to 1.
Line definitions (each has two colored parts):

Frame 68: "250+ " in #D4A8CC + "operatives expected." in #9898D0
Frame 88: "10+ " in #D4A8CC + "speakers." in #9898D0
Frame 106: "Unlimited " in #D4A8CC + "beer." in #9898D0
Frame 122: "Zero " in #D4A8CC + "rate limits." in #9898D0

Font size: 52px, weight 700, line-height 1.55. A block cursor character "▌" in #E8E4F0 follows the last visible character. While typing, cursor is solid. After line completes, cursor blinks (6-frame interval) for 60 frames, then disappears.
PHASE 5 — Settle + Glow (frames 140–175):
A large radial gradient div (900×700px, centered behind all content, filter: blur(60px)) fades from opacity 0 → settleGlow * glowPulse * 0.5 where settleGlow interpolates frame 140→160 as 0→1, and glowPulse = Math.sin(frame * 0.12) * 0.3 + 0.7. Color: rgba(192,160,216,0.25). This creates a subtle breathing glow behind the completed graphic. All cursors stop blinking by this phase.
OVERLAYS (entire duration):

CRT Scanlines: 540 horizontal lines, alternating 2px with rgba(255,255,255,0.012) and 2px transparent. Full canvas, pointer-events none, overall opacity 0.5.
CRT Flicker: Full-canvas div whose background alpha is driven by (Math.sin(frame * 1.7) + Math.sin(frame * 3.1)) mapped to a 0.97–1.03 range, then converted to a very subtle white overlay. Pointer-events none.

Both overlays render above all content for the entire composition.
Structure:
Use useCurrentFrame() and useVideoConfig() throughout. No TransitionSeries needed (single continuous scene). Each phase is controlled by frame-based springs and interpolations. The composition is a single <AbsoluteFill> with the dark background, then the centered content container, then the two overlays on top.

fix the Scene Error
Unexpected token, expected ";" (424:35)

The error is caused by the `:` JSX embedded inside a template literal / ternary within the `IntelHeader` component. JSX cannot be used inside a template literal expression. Let me fix that and also clean up the duplicate `` inside `
